root_cause.text: The `create_pending_snapshot` function in `fs/btrfs/transaction.c` treats the `-EOVERFLOW` error returned by `btrfs_uuid_tree_add()` when inserting `BTRFS_UUID_KEY_RECEIVED_SUBVOL` items as a fatal transaction failure, causing the filesystem to abort transactions and switch to read-only mode when the UUID tree leaf overflows from repeated snapshotting of received subvolumes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `fs/btrfs/transaction.c` in the `create_pending_snapshot` function to explicitly check `if (ret == -EOVERFLOW) ret = 0;` before the existing error handling logic, preventing the subsequent call to `btrfs_abort_transaction(trans, ret)` which would otherwise force the filesystem into read-only mode.
